title: RNA-seq Pipeline Parameters
description: Schema for the RNA-seq Nextflow pipeline parameters.

name.description: Comparison label used in output files.

control.description: Control group name from the metadata group column.

non_control.description: Non-control group name from the metadata group column.

project_name.description: Project name used for run metadata and reporting.

metadata_file.description: CSV file describing samples and FASTQ paths.

reference_auto_download.description: Automatically download and build missing reference files.

gtf_url.description: Source URL for the reference GTF file.

genome_fasta_url.description: Source URL for the reference genome FASTA file.

kallisto_threads.description: Number of threads for kallisto quantification and indexing.

skip_trimming.description: Skip fastp trimming and use raw reads for quantification.

save_trimmed.description: Publish trimmed FASTQ files to the output directory.

min_trimmed_reads.description: Minimum number of reads expected after trimming.
